_comment: Per-language baselines for bench/scope-capture/measure.mjs --check. fingerprint = order-independent sha256 over the lang-resolution/<lang>-* fixture corpus + a 20-entity synthetic source (correctness gate; re-baseline intentionally on a legitimate capture change). scaling_budget = max allowed (t800/t250)/(800/250); ~1.0 is linear, ~3.2 is quadratic. All six languages now thread the tree-sitter captured node instead of re-deriving it with findNodeAtRange(tree.rootNode,...) per match, so all are linear (go #1915, python #1918, ruby/php/rust/csharp this PR).

go._rebaselined: #1951: scope-resolution inheritance captures (@reference.inherits); legitimate capture-output change, scaling stays linear.

csharp._rebaselined: #1951: C# now synthesizes @reference.inherits captures from class/interface base lists (+ csharp-primary-ctor-heritage fixture); legitimate capture-output change, scaling stays linear (~1.06).

rust._rebaselined: #1956 review: + rust-cross-module-collision fixture (added to the rust-* corpus); capture-output addition only, existing fixtures byte-identical, scaling stays linear (~1.02).

php._rebaselined: #1951: scope-resolution inheritance captures (@reference.inherits); legitimate capture-output change, scaling stays linear.

ruby._rebaselined: #1951: scope-resolution inheritance captures (@reference.inherits); legitimate capture-output change, scaling stays linear.

swift._rebaselined: #1956 review: + swift-qualified-base fixture (added to the swift-* corpus); existing fixtures byte-identical (golden regen was purely additive), scaling stays linear (~1.07).

typescript._rebaselined: #1956 review: + typescript-generic-base fixture (added to the typescript-* corpus); scope-capture synth unchanged (only the legacy @heritage query was widened), existing fixtures byte-identical, scaling stays linear (~1.0).

javascript._added: #1951: bench coverage added (was ungated); js/kotlin O(n^2) findNodeAtRange-per-match fixed to threaded captured node, now linear.

kotlin._added: #1951: bench coverage added (was ungated); js/kotlin O(n^2) findNodeAtRange-per-match fixed to threaded captured node, now linear.
